ideas.pitch: Real-time carbon emission and elevation-optimized routing platform for local logistics and delivery fleets.
ideas.title: EcoRoute Cincinnati
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages localized geospatial mapping which appeals strongly to regional hybrid hackathon judges interested in civic utility, similar to GeoNex-ATLAS.

ideas.pitch: Automated community journalism and event aggregation agent that parses local Cincinnati town hall notes and calendars.
ideas.title: Midwest Localist AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets local community engagement, a classic hit for university-hosted regional hackathons with local stakeholder judges.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered patient acquisition and secure intake trust engine tailored for regional Midwestern dental and prosthodontic practices.
ideas.title: CliniqueTrust Ohio
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the exact architecture and hyper-targeted utility of Global-Smile, which won a 12-hour sprint by focusing strictly on local medical business conversion.

ideas.pitch: Personalized dining hall meal planner and nutritional compliance tracker built specifically for university student meal plans.
ideas.title: CampusEats AI Nutrition
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopts the proven consumer-health winning formula of E-Foodiee, focusing on an immediately relatable target demographic (college students) present at the event.

ideas.pitch: Forecasting tool for regional energy grid load anomalies and localized power outage risk using historical weather and consumption data.
ideas.title: GridWatch Cincinnati
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs rigorous regression and forecasting models with prediction intervals, matching the technical depth seen in AI-incident forecasting winners.
